data.title: Fix perf ACK framing, measured order, and validator bypasses
data.description: Consumes frozen perf ACKs as exact ack LF NUL frames while preserving the existing ack-LF ledger, emits perf_disable in canonical lexical order, and hardens overlay source validation by stripping Rust comments, enforcing top-level and function-body brace depths, rejecting unprovable conditionals, and testing comment-only and if-false bypasses. Both runner suites, overlay static tests, cargo/fmt checks, and real frozen perf and strace staged-child rehearsals pass.
